title: Understanding each other, one conversation at a time.
intro: We enrich our resources by networking with people from many different backgrounds who live in the Greater Boston area to work together to understand and help each other.
mission: We complete our mission by creating and running multihued activities and programs in six main areas: Education, Dialogue, Humanitarian aid, Advocacy, Religious and Community Services.
vision: We create inclusive programs in various areas that anyone and everyone can participate in, adding value to the Greater Boston area.
goalsTeaser: Facilitate unity for building peace, education to eradicate ignorance, welfare to fight poverty and hunger, and progress to promote development.
